Aerodrome Finance operates as a decentralized exchange on the Base blockchain. Aerodrome Finance uses an automated market maker model for trading. Aerodrome Finance is a fork of Velodrome. Aerodrome Finance uses a vote-escrowed tokenomics design. Aerodrome Finance is governed through its AERO token.

Injective is a layer-1 blockchain built with the Cosmos SDK. Injective uses proof-of-stake consensus. Injective provides an order-book-based decentralized exchange module. Injective supports interoperability with other chains through the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol.

Uniswap is a decentralized exchange deployed on the Ethereum blockchain. Uniswap uses an automated market maker with liquidity pools. Uniswap has released several versions, including V2 and V3. Uniswap V3 introduces concentrated liquidity. Uniswap is governed through its UNI governance token.

Yearn.finance operates as a yield aggregator on the Ethereum blockchain. Yearn.finance uses vaults that deposit user funds into automated strategies. Yearn.finance is governed through its YFI governance token.

Synthetix is a protocol for issuing synthetic assets on blockchain networks. Synthetix uses its SNX token as collateral for issued synthetic assets. Synthetix relies on external price oracles to determine asset values.
